entries.heading: SPECIAL EMERGENCY PROCUREMENT AUTHORITY TO FACILITATE THE DEFENSE AGAINST OR RECOVERY FROM A CYBER ATTACK
ancestors: TITLE XVI—STRATEGIC PROGRAMS, CYBER, AND INTELLIGENCE MATTERS
entries.text:
SEC. 1641. SPECIAL EMERGENCY PROCUREMENT AUTHORITY TO FACILITATE 
                          THE DEFENSE AGAINST OR RECOVERY FROM A 
                          CYBER ATTACK.

    Section 1903(a)(2) of title 41, United States Code, is amended by 
inserting ``cyber,'' before ``nuclear,''.

[[Page 130 STAT. 2601]]
